description:
FILES: extensions/status_line.ex, test/octo_pi/coder/extensions/status_line_test.exs

REQUIRES: opi-fin.2.2 (macro) and opi-fin.2.3 (load_from_factory verification) merged first.

CURRENT: def init(api, state) where state is an Agent pid provisioned by the caller. Closes over state in handlers via Agent.get_and_update.

TARGET:
1. Add 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension' at top of module.
2. Remove def init(api, state). The macro generates init/1.
3. Add: def mount, do: {:ok, %{turn_count: 0}}
4. Rename private on_session_start/1, on_turn_start/2, on_turn_end/2 to public handle_session_start/2, handle_turn_start/3, handle_turn_end/3 (3-arity for stateful ones, 2-arity for session_start which doesn't need state).
5. Replace Agent.get/get_and_update/update calls with direct state parameter reads/updates.
6. handle_turn_start and handle_turn_end return {result, new_state} tuple.
7. DO NOT change ctx.ui.set_status.(...) calls -- UI fn-field migration is Phase 7.
8. DO NOT change ctx.ui.apply_fg.(...) calls -- same.

TEST CHANGES: status_line_test.exs
- Remove outer Agent.start_link setup.
- Change load_from_factory call from factory fn with state injection to: Loader.load_from_factory('status-line', &StatusLine.init/1)
- All behavioral assertions (status is set, turn count increments) must still pass.
title: Migrate StatusLine to mount/0 pattern
